subject: Ensino Religioso
description_pt: Reconhecer funções e mensagens religiosas contidas nos mitos de criação (concepções de mundo, natureza, ser humano, divindades, vida e morte).

components.description_pt: Reconhecer as funções dos mitos de criação nas suas tradições religiosas
components.description_en: Recognize the functions of creation myths within their religious traditions
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how a modern fiction author adapts source material from myths, religious texts, or traditional stories

components.description_pt: Identificar mensagens religiosas sobre o mundo e natureza transmitidas em mitos de criação
components.description_en: Identify religious messages about the world and nature conveyed in creation myths
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how a modern fiction author adapts source material from myths, religious texts, or traditional stories

components.description_pt: Descrever concepções de humanidade, divindades, vida e morte expressas em mitos de criação
components.description_en: Describe conceptions of humanity, deities, life, and death expressed in creation myths
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how different cultures portray similar topics in myths and traditional literature

cc_matches.description: Analyze how a modern work of fiction draws on themes, patterns of events, or character types from myths, traditional stories, or religious works such as the Bible, including describing how the material is rendered new.

Compare and contrast the treatment of similar themes and topics (e.g., opposition of good and evil) and patterns of events (e.g., the quest) in stories, myths, and traditional literature from different cultures.
